description: Replace a config value at a given path. Wraps `config.set`. Destructive — overwrites the previous value. Prefer openclaw_config_patch for partial updates.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

path.description: Dotted path of the config key to set

value.description: New value — any JSON-serializable value (string, number, boolean, object, array, null). Passthrough: no schema enforced because the gateway config tree is open-typed.

name: openclaw_config_set
